purpose: Factorized evidence hypotheses, conservative model cascade, host-reviewed revisions and action proposals
selection: Choose regularization using development worst-language attribute macro-F1; never tune against final test
calibration: Separate language/task/class conditional split conformal, nominal alpha 0.05; no authentic-language coverage claim
cascade: Escalate unresolved lexical attributes to optional semantic challenger; preserve disagreements; no guarantee challenger is superior
release_gate: New workflow remains explicitly experimental unless held-out gains and review workload justify promotion; do not replace existing defaults based on training fit
limits: Factorial combinations share wording and are not independent observations
Source and subject are correlated in first controlled study
